title: Beyond Demographics: Fine-tuning Large Language Models to Predict Individuals’ Subjective Text Perceptions

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning and zero-shot prompting LLMs with annotator profiles containing combined demographic attributes (gender, race, age, education) to evaluate if models can generalize and predict demographic-specific subjective text perceptions across tasks like sentiment, offensiveness, and politeness.
Including annotator gender as part of a structured sociodemographic prompt to test if models can simulate gender-based variations in subjective text annotations.
Including annotator race/ethnicity as part of a structured sociodemographic prompt to test if models can simulate race-based variations in subjective text annotations.
Including annotator age groups as part of a structured sociodemographic prompt to test if models can simulate age-based variations in subjective text annotations.
Including annotator education level as part of a structured sociodemographic prompt to test if models can simulate education-based variations in subjective text annotations.
